p.inReviewBody: Several players have challenged the result. Vinko reviews it within 24 h. The Vinkos split is provisional.
dispute.why: What happened? Vinko will read it when reviewing.
dispute.ph: E.g.: the official result was the other one
dispute.mine: You challenged this result. If it reaches {m}, Vinko reviews it.
dispute.frozen: Challenged by {n}. Vinko reviews the result within 24 h. The Vinkos already split are provisional.
dispute.upheld: Vinko reviewed a challenge and kept this result.
dispute.reversed: Result corrected by Vinko after a challenge. The previous split was undone.
dispute.errWindow: The 24 h window to challenge is over.
dispute.errParticipant: Only players who took part can challenge.
dispute.errState: This porra no longer accepts challenges.
dispute.errClosed: Vinko already reviewed this result and kept it.
dispute.errReason: Briefly say what happened (at least 3 characters).
admin.porras.disputedHow: Frozen by their players. Keep returns the porra to resolved with the same split. Correct undoes the split (as far as balances allow; any gap is recorded as shortfall), undoes the skill points and resolves with the winner you pick. Reopen undoes the split and lets the judge resolve again.
admin.porras.kept: Result kept. The porra is resolved again.
admin.porras.rectified: Corrected: «{o}» wins. Split undone and redone.
admin.porras.reopened: Reopened: split undone, the judge must resolve again.
admin.porras.disputeErr: Could not decide the challenge. If the porra was resolved before the ledger existed (VINKO_NO_LEDGER), fix it by hand.
